entries.c9c1dad5af265a9f: Taki Chemical Co.,Ltd. is a chemical manufacturer headquartered in Kakogawa City, Hyogo Prefecture, and forms a group with 15 subsidiaries and 4 affiliates. Consolidated employees number 640 (as of December 31, 2025). It began in 1885 with the manufacture of fertilizers.
entries.cd25371953bb47d8: Its strengths are that the ultra-high-basicity polyaluminum chloride it developed in-house for water treatment chemicals is gaining market penetration; that it has functional materials such as high-purity tantalum oxide for smartphones and highly basic aluminum chloride for automotive ceramic fibers; and that it has begun development that combines the microbial culture and enzyme agent technologies of Rakuto Kasei Kogyo, which it made a subsidiary in 2025, with its own technologies. Manufacturing technology accumulated from fertilizers is being extended to each field of chemical products.

entries.f935a7aa5e008c7d: The company is pursuing its five-year Medium-Term Management Plan 2028, with 2024 as its first year. Its basic policies are (1) active investment in growth businesses and the creation of new businesses, (2) improving earnings power by deepening existing businesses, (3) practicing sustainability transformation, and (4) promoting ＧＲＣ. Under its Long-Term Vision 2050, which sets as its desired future state 'the practice of a sustainable business strategy that considers the environment, society and local communities,' it is working on expanding medical materials and collagen materials into the life science field, developing and expanding sales of functional materials, and commercializing 'Bakamatsutake.'
